title: Administrator
description:
Office Administrator
Location: Wellingborough
Pay Rate: 12.71 per hour
Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am-5pm
Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and organised Office Administrator to join our busy depot in Wellingborough.
The ideal candidate will come from a construction, plant hire, industrial, or logistics background and be comfortable operating in a fast-paced commercial environment. You will be a core point of contact for administrative operations, liaising between hire controllers, workshop fitters, drivers, and external clients to keep depot processes running smoothly.
Key Responsibilities
Hire & Depot Administration
- Process and log plant machine hires, off-hires, and extensions using internal software systems.
- Raise and track purchase orders, cross-referencing transport movement sheets, delivery notes, and cross-hires.
- Assist with transport and driver logistics paperwork
- Prepare accurately detailed off-hire damage/breakdown notes in coordination with workshop engineers.

Account & Compliance Support
- Check timecards, job sheets, and driver logs for accuracy before submitting for payroll/invoicing.
- Liaise with the central finance team to resolve invoice queries, purchase order discrepancies, and supplier credits.
- Maintain compliance records (e.g., machine maintenance logs, service certifications, health & safety documentation).

Customer Service & General Office Support
- Answer incoming calls and emails, directing customer enquiries to the relevant hire controller or department.
- Welcome depot visitors, delivery drivers, and contractors while ensuring site health & safety sign-in protocols are followed.
- Order office supplies, manage incoming/outgoing mail, and maintain organised digital and physical filing systems.

Essential Requirements & Qualifications
- Experience: Proven administration experience within a construction, plant hire, engineering, industrial, or haulage/logistics environment.
- Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with plant machinery terminology (e.g., excavators, dumpers, telehandlers) and hire office procedures is strongly preferred.
- IT Literacy: Tech-savvy with proficiency in Microsoft Office and comfortable learning bespoke plant management software.
- Attention to Detail: Excellent numerical and analytical skills with high accuracy when cross-checking hire contracts, POs, and invoices.
- Communication: Clear, confident telephone manner and professional email etiquette when dealing with clients, drivers, and depot staff.
- Work Ethic: Proactive, self-motivated, and capable of prioritising tasks under tight operational deadlines.

title: Executive Assistant- Part Time
description:
Part Time Executive Assistant

Location: Kettering
Salary: 24,500- 29,500 + bonus
Type: Part-Time, Permanent

About the Business:

We're recruiting on behalf of a highly successful and well-established business based in Kettering.

This is a business that genuinely values its people.

They're ambitious, growing and commercially successful, but they've managed to maintain a supportive, down-to-earth culture where people work together and enjoy what they do.

The leadership team is visible.

The business is well run.

And people are trusted to get on with their jobs.

You'll be joining a company where relationships matter, teamwork is valued and where you'll quickly become a central part of how the business operates.

The Opportunity:

This isn't a traditional EA role supporting one individual.

This is a role at the heart of the business.

You'll provide executive support to the Managing Director and a wider Leadership Team of Directors, acting as the person who keeps everything organised, coordinated and running smoothly.

You'll manage busy diaries.

Coordinate meetings.

Arrange UK and international travel.

Support company events and conferences.

And become the trusted point of contact for senior stakeholders across the organisation.

No two days will look the same.

One minute you could be coordinating overseas travel and visas.

The next you'll be preparing information for a board meeting or organising a major company event.

If you're someone who loves being organised, enjoys working with senior people and gains satisfaction from making things happen behind the scenes, this is the kind of role you'll thrive in.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Providing executive support to the Managing Director and Leadership Team
- Managing complex diaries and meeting schedules
- Coordinating leadership, sales and company-wide meetings
- Organising UK and international travel arrangements and visas
- Managing expenses for senior leaders
- Supporting customer hospitality events and business functions
- Assisting with divisional conferences and leadership events
- Preparing reports, presentations and information packs for senior management
- Acting as a key point of contact across the business
- Supporting office management and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations

Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, highly professional and enjoys operating in a fast-paced environment and has experience providing executive support for multiple Leaders.

The type of person who spots problems before they happen.

The type of person who loves a well-managed diary.

The type of person who gets genuine satisfaction from keeping everything running smoothly.

You'll probably be someone who:
- Has previous Executive Assistant or Senior PA experience
- Is comfortable supporting multiple senior stakeholders
- Can prioritise competing demands without becoming flustered
- Has exceptional organisational skills
- Communicates confidently with people at all levels
- Takes ownership and uses initiative
- Pays close attention to detail
- Remains calm under pressure
- Enjoys building relationships across a business
- Loves being the person others rely on

This role won't suit someone who likes to sit back and wait for instructions.

We need someone proactive.

Someone who thinks ahead.

Someone who enjoys being one step in front of everyone else.

What's On Offer:
- Competitive salary
- Pension scheme
- Company benefits package
- Free onsite parking
- A varied and highly visible role
- The opportunity to work closely with senior decision makers
- A supportive and collaborative culture
- Long-term stability with a successful and growing business
- The chance to become a genuine business partner to the leadership team

Why This Role Is Different:

Lots of EA roles talk about working closely with leadership.

This one actually does.

You'll be involved in everything from strategic meetings and international travel to major events and company-wide initiatives.

You'll see how the business operates.

You'll work alongside senior leaders every day.

And you'll play a key role in helping them perform at their best.

For the right person, it's a fantastic opportunity to become one of the most important support functions within the organisation.

Please apply with an up-to-date CV.

Please note, due to the high volumes of applications we receive daily, should you not be contacted within 72 hours, your application is unsuccessful.

Impact Recruitment is an employment business working on behalf of our client.

All responses will be managed in line with the new GDPR regulations.

title: Part-time Accounts Assistant
description:
Part-time Accounts Assistant, 25 hrs per week, bookkeeping, Daventry, to £30,000 FTE

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organised Accounts Assistant to join our established client's Internal accounts team based in both their Daventry and Blisworth offices.

The ideal candidate will have experience in Bookkeeping and accounting and using various accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks and Sage. This is a part time position of 25 hours per week.

As the Accounts Assistant, your duties will include:
- Sales invoicing - Raise and process all sales invoices. This includes recurring invoices and ad-hoc invoices.
- Purchase Ledger - Verify purchase invoices and receipts, reconcile against supplier statement & prepare payment schedules, where applicable.
- Bank - Maintain an up-to-date cash book for all accounts and reconcile against the bank statement monthly.
- Expenses - Process employee claims and arrange re-imbursements.
- Credit control - Ensuring all outstanding accounts are chased appropriately.

We are looking for previous experience covering the areas below:

Accounts preparation and bookkeeping

Software such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage. (not essential)

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in work

Excellent organisational skills to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Benefits:

Competitive salary based on experience

Opportunities for career growth and development within the finance department

Training provided on specialised accounting software

If you are a meticulous individual with a passion for finance and possess the required skills, we welcome your application for the role of Accounts Assistant.

title: Administrative Assistant
description: We are looking for a friendly, organised and reliable Administrative Assistant to join our team and provide essential administrative support to our reception team and the wider practice. This is a varied and rewarding role involving front-desk reception, telephone support, patient liaison and general administrative duties. You will be an important part of the practice team, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient running of our busy GP practice while providing a welcoming and professional service to our patients. The successful candidate will be a confident and approachable communicator who is able to build positive relationships with patients and colleagues. You will be well organised, able to prioritise and manage competing tasks effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility is important, as you will be expected to work collaboratively across different areas of the practice and provide support to other teams when required. We are looking for someone who is proactive, adaptable and takes pride in delivering a high standard of service. This role is based across two practice sites, located approximately one mile apart. Hours of Work Monday to Friday Varied working pattern covering the practices core hours between 8.00am - 6.30pm The successful candidate will provide professional front-desk and administrative support within the practice, assisting patients, managing appointments and enquiries, processing registrations and documentation, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring confidentiality. Support both clinical and non-clinical teams to help maintain the smooth and efficient running of the practice. Key Responsibilities Provide support to the reception team and wider practice. Welcome and assist patients at the front desk in a professional and friendly manner. Answer incoming telephone calls and deal with enquiries appropriately. Liaise with patients by telephone, in person and through other appropriate communication channels. Book, amend and manage patient appointments. Handle general administrative tasks and ensure work is completed accurately and efficiently. Process patient registrations and related documentation. Scan, upload and accurately file documents and correspondence. Deal with prescription enquiries and direct requests to the appropriate team where necessary. Manage emails and respond to or action enquiries appropriately. Provide administrative support to clinical and non-clinical teams when required. Maintain confidentiality and handle patient information in accordance with practice policies and procedures. Assist with maintaining accurate and up-to-date records. Support the smooth running of the reception and administrative functions. Undertake any other reasonable duties required to support the practice and its teams.
